paras: Our accuracy had been stuck for months. We had the data, we had a model, and __no idea what to try next__.

Suraj did not hand us a roadmap. He sat with the team and *made us systematic* — how to define a dataset, when to retrain, how to choose a model and why. Three months later the module went from *43% to 93%*.
Then the calls started coming in: *enterprise deals* we could not have had before.
I had spent two years building something I believed in, and __I could not get it to move__. Not for lack of effort. For *lack of clarity* — and *no reliable partner*.
One month with Suraj and I could finally see it — who my users were, what they actually needed, and *what to build first*.
Two months later I was ready for market. In the third month I launched. *Users came.* And revenue, which until then I had only imagined, started showing up.

2 to 8 weeks, based on what you need.
